offering_description.value: Provides finished-vehicle transportation and logistics for automakers, dealers, auctions and rental companies. Moves new and used vehicles by truck carrier, arranging loads through its own network and third-party carriers.

primary_services.value: vehicle transportation; logistics management; freight brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers, auto dealerships, wholesale auction houses, vehicle rental fleets

end_markets.value: automotive; vehicle rental; wholesale auctions; retail auto dealers

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for transporting and moving vehicles for customers; project or contract: contracted shipping volume agreements with automakers and rental companies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: moves vehicles for automakers, dealers and rental fleets, billing per shipment

geography_served.value: US national: Shipping lanes across most US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: vehicle transport and logistics only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with automakers, dealers and rental companies; agents / brokers: freight brokers and third-party carrier networks

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: federal motor carrier safety and transport rules from FMCSA and DOT for trucks and drivers

notes: Description is from general knowledge and the service mix and footprint may have changed.
